P14_TRANSITION_CONFLICT: more than one same-priority authoritative transition in one tick
P14_TICK_INVALID: tick is negative, non-integer or non-monotonic
P14_COMMAND_STAGE: command emitted in forbidden A-M stage
P14_EVENT_SCHEMA: unknown field, type or invalid payload
P14_HASH_INTERVAL: checkpoint missing or emitted at wrong tick
P14_HARD_LIMIT: battle reached 5400 ticks without terminal resolution
P14_RANDOM_ACCESS: random draw attempted outside authorized context
P14_INPUT_NOT_READY: real G13 or required API evidence missing
P14_G13_NOT_PROVEN: gate G13 (PRNG/replay) has no real reproducible proof yet
P14_RULES_API_UNVERIFIED: phase 11 rules/units/IDs APIs not verified against real code
P14_PRNG_REPLAY_API_UNVERIFIED: phase 13 PRNG/replay APIs not verified against real code
P14_CONTENT_TYPES_UNVERIFIED: content types and simulationVersion not verified from compiler output
P14_TRACEABILITY_MISSING: traceability from events to content IDs missing
